Crop tool photos before they are posted, and crop member avatars as well (Teo asked for it). Today the catalogue thumbnails are cut to the middle by the API (api/src/photos/resize.ts, cover fit, centred) and tool photos go up uncropped. Decided 2026-03-24: photos only (no clips), no turning. One shared crop sheet, used in two places: (1) Member avatar — after picking a picture, a fixed circle frame, drag and pinch to place it, Save; this replaces the automatic middle cut. (2) Posting a tool — a Crop button on every photo in the upload tray (each photo cropped on its own when several are added), with Free and Square shapes. How: the browser only picks the rectangle; it uploads the full-size original together with the rectangle (normalised 0–1, measured on the upright picture), and the API runs sharp on it — turn first with rotate(), then extract the rectangle — before any thumbnail is made. No canvas re-encode, so nothing is lost, and phone HEIC pictures keep taking the existing server path. The stored original becomes the cropped picture, so the detail page, the download button and the gallery all show the crop. Preset constraint: the component kit has no cropper, so write one by hand (pointer events for drag and pinch, a crop box over a dimmed layer, preset tokens for the buttons) instead of pulling in a crop library with its own look. Roughly half a day of gesture work. Camera shots follow the same tray flow. Batch with the round-avatars note.
